records.translation: Mahika ng Gubat

records.source: You are one with forest magic...
records.translation: Kaisa ka ng mahika ng gubat...

records.source: Blackberries and Salmonberries are worth 3x the gold.
records.translation: Tatlong beses ang halaga ng mga Blackberry at Salmonberry.
records.englishResidueReason: Blackberry and Salmonberry are the established fruit names in the Filipino glossary and translation.

records.source: Spring onions are worth 5x the gold.
records.translation: Limang beses ang halaga ng mga Sibuyas ng Tagsibol.

records.source: 'I'm not around, but you can still make a purchase using the animal catalogue!'  -Marnie
records.translation: 'Wala ako rito, pero maaari ka pa ring bumili gamit ang Katalogo ng mga Hayop!'  -Marnie

records.source: Special Items & Powers
records.translation: Mga Natatanging Bagay at Kapangyarihan

records.source: The old tree is gone... However, with 100 pieces of hardwood, this could be fixed up.
records.translation: Wala na ang matandang puno... Gayunman, maaari itong ayusin gamit ang 100 piraso ng Matigas na Kahoy.

records.source: Use 100 pieces of hardwood to fix up the stump?
records.translation: Gumamit ng 100 piraso ng Matigas na Kahoy upang ayusin ang tuod?

records.source: Maybe someone will decide to move in...
records.translation: Baka may magpasiyang manirahan dito...

records.source: Um... There appears to be some kind of... anomalous reading... I... don't know what this means...
records.translation: Um... Mukhang may isang uri ng... kakaibang indikasyon... Hindi ko... alam kung ano ang ibig sabihin nito...

records.source: The raccoon shop has been expanded.
records.translation: Pinalawak ang tindahan ng rakun.

records.source: Another player is talking to the Raccoon right now.
records.translation: May ibang manlalarong nakikipag-usap sa Rakun ngayon.

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need fish...
records.translation: Rakun: Gutom... kailangan ng isda...

records.source: Raccoon: Now, maybe I find a wife...
records.translation: Rakun: Ngayon, baka makahanap ako ng asawa...

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need fruit...
records.translation: Rakun: Gutom... kailangan ng prutas...

records.source: Raccoon: Now, we start a family...
records.translation: Rakun: Ngayon, bubuo kami ng pamilya...

records.source: Raccoon: Hungry... need mushroom...
records.translation: Rakun: Gutom... kailangan ng kabute...

records.source: Raccoon: Now we can grow the family bigger...
records.translation: Rakun: Ngayon, mapalalaki pa namin ang pamilya...

records.source: Raccoon: Thirsty... need juice...
records.translation: Rakun: Nauuhaw... kailangan ng katas...

records.source: Raccoon: You're a good friend, bobo. Now we can have another...
records.translation: Rakun: Mabuti kang kaibigan, bobo. Ngayon, maaari kaming magkaroon ng isa pa...
records.englishResidueReason: bobo is preserved as the raccoon's recurring invented form of address in the English source.

records.source: Raccoon: Psst... bobo. I need a gift for the missus.
records.translation: Rakun: Psst... bobo. Kailangan ko ng regalo para sa asawa ko.
records.englishResidueReason: bobo is preserved as the raccoon's recurring invented form of address in the English source.

records.source: Raccoon: We're happy for now, bobo...
records.translation: Rakun: Masaya kami sa ngayon, bobo...
records.englishResidueReason: bobo is preserved as the raccoon's recurring invented form of address in the English source.

records.source: Raccoon: Help us, and I'll give you something nice.
records.translation: Rakun: Tulungan mo kami, at bibigyan kita ng magandang bagay.

records.source: Raccoon: We're doing great, bobo...
records.translation: Rakun: Mabuti ang kalagayan namin, bobo...
records.englishResidueReason: bobo is preserved as the raccoon's recurring invented form of address in the English source.

records.source: Raccoon: Thanks, bobo. Take this...
records.translation: Rakun: Salamat, bobo. Kunin mo ito...
records.englishResidueReason: bobo is preserved as the raccoon's recurring invented form of address in the English source.

records.source: It's a big tree, but the wood is starting to rot...
records.translation: Malaking puno ito, ngunit nagsisimula nang mabulok ang kahoy...

records.source: There was a strong wind storm during the night...
records.translation: Nagkaroon ng malakas na unos kagabi...

records.source: You don't yet have the knowledge to use this...
records.translation: Wala ka pang sapat na kaalaman upang gamitin ito...

records.source: Mystery Boxes can now be found...
records.translation: Makakahanap ka na ngayon ng mga Kahong Misteryo...

records.source: You sense that a new way is open...
records.translation: Nararamdaman mong may bagong landas na nabuksan...

records.source: Meadowlands Farm_It's not the best for growing crops, but there's a chewy blue grass that animals love. You start with two chickens.
records.translation: Bukid na Damuhan_Hindi ito ang pinakamainam para sa pagtatanim, ngunit may makunat na asul na damong gustong-gusto ng mga hayop. Magsisimula ka na may dalawang manok.
